name: Blockchain / Cryptocurrency Developer
description: Implement blockchain primitives, consensus algorithms, wallets, and smart contract interactions. Understand cryptography and distributed systems.
example_snippet:
program SimpleBlock:
    shape Block holds:
        Index as whole number
        PreviousHash as text
        Timestamp as whole number
        Data as text
        Hash as text
        Nonce as whole number
    end shape

    action calculate_hash takes B as const ref Block produces text:
        # Simplified - would use SHA-256
        produce success with "hash_placeholder"
    end action

    keep Genesis as Block
    put 0 into Genesis.Index
    put "0" into Genesis.PreviousHash
    put 0 into Genesis.Timestamp
    put "Genesis Block" into Genesis.Data
    put 0 into Genesis.Nonce

    call calculate_hash with Genesis giving Genesis.Hash
    print the text "Genesis hash: " and Genesis.Hash and newline
end program
status_note: dictum_net.c (P2P sockets), dictum_file.c (block storage), dictum_tls.c (secure comms) all implemented. Crypto hashing requires C import OpenSSL.
